learning_outcomes.text: Designs experimental systems for machine testing.
Models vibrational phenomena in structural elements and machines using numerical methods and specific software.

Analyzes a problem and designs an algorithm that solves it. Understands and applies different algorithmic control structures. Works with files capable of storing large amounts of data. Represents data graphically and manipulates it effectively. Designs processes for the numerical solution of problems with linear and non-linear equation systems.
Knows the characteristics and applications of sensors and control elements.
Analyzes the dynamics of mechanical assemblies considering drives and their regulation.

syllabus_topics: Continuous systems and computational modal analysis
Stability and control of single degree of freedom systems
teaching_methods: Introductory activities (General description of the subject)
Lectures (Classes for the development of theoretical concepts)
Problem/exercise solving in the ordinary classroom (Classes for the development of practical and application problems)
PBL (Problem Based Learning) / (ABP) Problem-Based Learning (Student resolution of problems in class, applying fundamental theoretical and practical concepts)

assessment_methods.method: Practical tests (Practical application work using computational tools)

assessment_rules: The minimum grade in each continuous assessment test must be higher than 3.5. For the second call, the exam will cover the entire subject material and will have a weight of 100%.
